newsitem.title: FINLAND: Big in-house deals in UPM, Enso.
newsitem.headline: Big in-house deals in UPM, Enso.

text.p: Big in-house deals by state-owned bank Postipankki's brokerage boosted volumes in Finnish forest industry groups UPM-Kymmene Oy and Enso Oy on Wednesday. Postipankki brokers declined comment on the deals.

Postipankki traded in-house more than eight million UPM-Kymmene shares worth about 792 million markka at 94.00 markka per share, down 3.70 for the day, and in a separate deal more than 12 million Enso R shares worth some 470 million markka, 37.30 markka per share, down 0.70.
An Enso spokeswoman said she did not know who the buyer or seller were.
A UPM official also said he did not know the participants of the deals.
Later, Finnish state-owned asset management company Sponda Oy said its subsidiaries had sold the shares to the Sponda Oy parent company.
The shares traded by Postipankki account for about three percent of shares in UPM and about five percent of shares in Enso.
